title: LogicDiff: LLM-Guided Compress–Generate–Restore for Trustworthy Tabular Synthesis
summary: A research pipeline built on TabDDPM that compresses tabular data via an LLM-derived schema, generates synthetic rows, and restores them to the original column space, benchmarking against several tabular generators. Among its baselines it vendors the sdv-dev CTGAN package in-tree and calls its CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer to produce comparison synthetic data.
evidence: baselines/CTGAN/train_sample_tvae.py:5-41 imports and instantiates TVAESynthesizer from vendored CTGAN.ctgan as a baseline
